title: Corpus Christi+ Feminist official site

data.notes: Current first-party site explicitly self-describes as a mutual aid feminist group serving Corpus Christi and surrounding areas, centered on equality, respect and collective empowerment. Public organization contact: (361) 236-2369.

title: The Free Store Corpus Christi official site and contact

data.notes: Current first-party site describes a Corpus Christi 501(c)(3), operating since 2022, using low/no-barrier street outreach to distribute clothing, meals, first aid and other resources. Official contact page lists 361-319-0933 and freestorecc2022@gmail.com.

title: City of Corpus Christi current Free Store partnership reference

data.notes: City says it partners with The Free Store to provide cold-weather items to emergency-refuge guests and lists The Free Store Corpus Christi with 361-319-0933. title: BG Neighbors Aid Network street-outreach profile

data.notes: Bowling Green group conducts weekly street outreach with meals, supplies, medical care and well-being support. Public communications listed by the organization through WNKY: Instagram @bg_neighbors, Facebook page BG Neighbors Aid Network, and bgneighbors.aid@gmail.com.

title: BG Neighbors Aid Network current Warren County resource listing

data.notes: Current public resource hub describes weekly Bowling Green outreach delivering meals, gear, hygiene supplies, street medicine, transportation and well checks. It lists bgneighbors.aid@gmail.com and 615-581-7106. 2026 Warren County warming-center reporting also names BG Neighbors Aid Network as a current service partner.

title: Rise and Shine Bowling Green mutual-aid history and status check

data.notes: Profile says Rise and Shine was founded in Bowling Green in 2021 as a community-led mutual-aid organization building power and solidarity with low-income, BIPOC, LGBTQ+ and other marginalized communities. Public hub https://linktr.ee/riseandshinebgky and Instagram handle @riseandshinebgky remain discoverable; October 2025 Reddit discovery questioned whether the group was still active because social accounts appeared stale, so current status is unresolved.

title: Salt Lake City Food Not Bombs 2025 city microgrant profile

data.notes: Salt Lake City lists the local Food Not Bombs chapter as operating continuously since 1999 and supporting ongoing free food recovery/distribution, volunteer deliveries and a community garden. This establishes recent continuity independent of historical Food Not Bombs directories.

title: Wasatch Tenants United official site

data.notes: Current first-party site self-describes as a Salt Lake City/Wasatch Valley grassroots political organization for dignified housing and explicitly lists mutual aid among its organizing methods. First-party Instagram handle: @wasatchtenants. Public hub: https://linktr.ee/WasatchTenants, which exposes Instagram, Facebook and Twitter surfaces.

title: Gear Fund Collective official site

data.notes: Current first-party Salt Lake City site explicitly calls the project mutual aid rather than charity and describes a horizontal model with no hierarchy or leadership, volunteer organization and anti-oppression commitments. The site exposes an Instagram surface, but the exact handle was not resolved in this pass.

title: Central Wasatch Commission Gear Fund Collective partnership

data.notes: Commission describes Gear Fund Collective as a mutual-aid collective redistributing outdoor gear free of charge and documents a Salt Lake City gear-shed partnership. A June 2025 Reddit thread raised uncertainty about responsiveness while another commenter reported an active collection drive; organizational presence is retained as current/recent with responsiveness uncertainty.

title: Area-code-hunt shard B bounded pass — 361 / 364 / 385

data.research_question: Enumerate public organizations associated with the next unresolved authoritative U.S. geographic shard-B NPAs 361, 364 and 385, preserving status, provenance and uncertainty and following verified public organization edges outward.
data.method: Authoritative NANPA admission before deterministic B sharding; literal area-code/anarchist/ABC/Food Not Bombs/mutual-aid searches plus locality-derived Corpus Christi, Bowling Green and Salt Lake City searches; first-party and current local/government corroboration preferred; historical directories used only as discovery/status seeds; repository search used for canonical-ID dedupe.
classification_rules: Do not infer anarchist identity from mutual-aid, abolitionist, horizontal or adjacent language alone.
Historical directories and stale public hubs do not establish current activity.
Do not merge organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
A completed area code is not repeated without new evidence.
